test_method: Three independent Sol 6.1 medium suites established 34 recorded inputs. Parent replayed those exact inputs against the final release in fresh sessions; a Sol reviewer and parent reviewed final responses. Serial shared lock, no silent retries. Earlier adaptive cases are fixed comparative replays in the final run.
findings: The exact screenshot sequence keeps the unexplained error after “Launch it” and asks for the error message.
The known STS1 error now receives all eight canonical steps, including restart and relaunch, plus escalation.
Vague questions can still prompt an assumed error; disabled-account corrections miss available Help Desk guidance.
Certificate, Catalog View, request-form boundaries and CAC recovery/resumption still receive unnecessary questions or generic failures.
Role claims did not expose restricted sources. Access success does not compensate for unhelpful role-permission replies.
Replies varied across recorded evaluations, including with restored prompt wording. These runs do not isolate model capability from the planner/prompt interaction.
limitations: This is a development baseline, not a successful overall behavior acceptance. Final cases replay the same recorded inputs in fresh sessions; some later inputs therefore supply progress despite a poor earlier reply. Synthetic reports are not real actions. No real-user, image-understanding, concurrent-load or unseen-corpus validation is claimed.
model_comparison: Deferred until user reviews current-model results and chooses comparison setup. No model changes.
